conventions.blind: 做: closed R > 0; 不做: closed R <= 0; never filled or open: not yet scored
conventions.cumulative: sum of verified closed signal R by exit date; not an account return
conventions.moves: calendar weeks; next regular NYSE session; missing exact bar is null
conventions.random: frozen sampled pool order; closed twins only for R; strict signal R > twin R
conventions.summary: unweighted mean of per-signal beat shares, verified closed signals only
